given_when_then.given: A Delivery Proof is successfully recorded for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system generates a Financial Transaction Record with correct split amounts for all parties

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Proof is missing or invalid for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to process the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review

given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The system pauses financial distribution for manual verification before settlement

given_when_then.given: The system calculates settlement amounts for an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The system processes the settlement event
given_when_then.then: The sum of all distributed amounts must equal the total value of the Financial Transaction Record

given_when_then.given: A delivery is completed regardless of outcome
given_when_then.when: The system processes the post-delivery event
given_when_then.then: A Financial Transaction Record is generated for every completed delivery

success_criteria: System generates a Financial Transaction Record with correct split amounts for all parties when a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
System prevents financial distribution and flags the Order Request for manual review if the Delivery Proof is missing or invalid.
System pauses financial distribution for manual verification if high-risk indicators are detected.
System ensures the sum of all distributed amounts equals the total value of the Financial Transaction Record.
System strictly adheres to the terms defined in the Store Partner Agreement during settlement calculations.
System generates a Financial Transaction Record for every completed delivery regardless of outcome.
